title: Moon illusion answer
summary: An AI answer explains that the moon looks bigger near the horizon because of context.
text: Ask Psst. Why does the moon look bigger near the horizon? It’s an illusion, not a change in size. Your brain compares the moon with trees, buildings, and the horizon. Same moon, different context.
